summary: The HTML is a faithful and safe generated view of the frozen Markdown source. The embedded source hash and render sidecar match the current source, the render sidecar's HTML hash matches the current HTML, and an independent in-memory rerender is byte-identical after normalizing only the generation timestamp. All 40 headings, 18 tables, 6 code blocks, 45 protected math expressions, 6 source details blocks plus the generated navigation details block, and 5 embedded SVGs are accounted for. The five decoded SVG payload hashes match the author assets recorded in the render sidecar. No event-handler attributes, unsafe javascript/vbscript URL schemes, or placeholders were found; the two script tags are the renderer's fixed MathJax configuration and pinned jsDelivr MathJax loader. The lab's toy ANLS, leave-one-out VQA consensus, continuous-coordinate IoU, transitive grouping/purge and exact deduplication, and equal-parent paired percentile bootstrap are correct for their explicitly stated teaching conventions. Existing tests pass and the CLI exactly reproduces the published toy counts, delta, and interval. No important factual or citation mismatch was found in the reviewed scope.

safety.embedded_data_urls: five data:image/svg+xml;base64 payloads only; each decoded hash matches the recorded local author asset
